title: Wake-Rider Current
message: An incredibly fast current catches you before there is time to brace for disaster. Instead, it carries you along a perfectly safe route at ridiculous speed. A sign flashes past: "WHEEEEE - I mean, DANGER." The ride deposits you beside {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Titanbone Arch
message: You pass beneath a pale stone arch, then another, then dozens more fading into the distance. Only when the curves connect do you realize they are ribs and you are walking through part of an ancient Leviathan cage. Among the remains lie {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Pressurejaw Drop
message: Two cliff walls frame a descent into the dark. Their surfaces gradually resolve into upper and lower jawbones, complete with a tooth larger than you are. A fracture in that colossal tooth holds {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Sheltering Scale
message: A violent current drives you beneath what looks like a rocky overhang. It is a single gigantic scale. Scratched underneath are the words, "Cozy! Ignore what this used to be attached to. - S" When the surge passes, {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note glint nearby.

title: Currentbreaker Run
message: You struggle against a current powerful enough to bend wreckage. Something enormous shifts far beyond sight, and the water abruptly becomes still. An old note reads, "If the water suddenly stops moving, don't ask why." In the unsettling calm, {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note settle into view.

title: Bonegarden Field
message: Hundreds of gigantic bones rise like pale trees from the seafloor. Tiny harmless creatures have built nests, gardens, and glowing homes along them, turning the remains into a peaceful city. One little nest contains {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Hullsplitter Wreck
message: An old ship has been split and impaled upon an enormous spine. You enter one half of the wreck, cross directly through an ancient vertebra, and emerge inside the other half, where the surviving hold contains {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Wakefoam Surge
message: Colliding currents pile luminous wakefoam into towers. A tiny creature surfs past on a scrap of wreckage as though this is entirely normal, then crashes into debris with considerably less dignity. The impact spills {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Deep-Scar Path
message: A narrow geological trench runs across the seabed with suspiciously regular edges. Four parallel cuts appear nearby, and the truth becomes unavoidable: they are ancient claw marks. Inside one scar rest {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Walking Scale
message: A detached Leviathan scale begins to crawl across the seabed. Tension builds as something moves beneath it, until a very small crab emerges carrying the colossal scale as its shell. Its absurd trail leads past {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Riptide Crossing
message: Intersecting riptides force you to cross from bone to bone for shelter. Old navigation arrows mark a survivable route until one points into the worst current beside the admission, "I regret this shortcut." The corrected path reaches {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Wrecknest Gap
message: Small sea creatures have built an entire colony from shattered ships: tiny walls, roofs, lanes, and a doorway far too small for you. After watching your failed attempt to approach, the residents push {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note politely through the door.

title: Tectonic Shelf
message: The shelf trembles like an earthquake, but the vibration moves away in a perfectly straight line. Something enormous has passed beneath or beyond the stone without ever becoming visible. When the shaking fades, the opened ground reveals {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Roarcurrent Gorge
message: A biological-sounding roar shakes the gorge until you find its source: current rushing through cavities in an enormous ancient skull. The skull has become a colossal flute, and its deepest note vibrates {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note from a hollow.

title: Abysslung Shadow
message: An impossibly large shadow passes over you. Looking upward reveals nothing at all. Nearby, an old scrap contains a single word: "Nope." The darkness eventually moves on, leaving {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note exposed on the pale seabed.

title: Marrowlight Ossuary
message: Blue-white Marrowlight glows from within enormous bones, illuminating thousands of tiny organisms that have transformed the skeleton into a living reef. The serene light travels along one rib and reveals {reward} Star Candies beside a Travel Note.

title: Titanwake Delta
message: Several major currents intersect around a half-buried skeleton. Local creatures use them like roads, and you are accidentally swept into their orderly traffic. After three dizzying junctions, the delta deposits you beside {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Pressure Bloom
message: Deep-sea flowers lie tightly closed across the plain. A massive pressure wave sweeps over them, and thousands bloom at once until the entire seafloor becomes a field of light. Between the luminous petals appear {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Shipgrave Maze
message: Dozens of wrecks wedged between Leviathan ribs form a sprawling maze. Old arrows cover every surface, contradicting one another until a final message admits, "Okay I may have made this worse." The least impossible route reaches {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Scarfin Torrent
message: Something shaped like an enormous fin cuts through the torrent. It turns out to be broken ancient armor, bearing the words "GOT ME TOO" across its surface. The sweeping plate catches debris, a Travel Note, and {reward} Star Candies before grinding to a halt.

title: Colossus Trail
message: Calling the depression a footprint feels absurd; it is practically a crater. More prints continue beyond visibility, and this one now contains an entire small ecosystem. Among its pools and miniature reefs are {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Thunderwake Storm
message: Distant currents collide hard enough to produce underwater thunder. Each flash of pressure-light reveals a colossal skeleton in the dark, then another farther away, then another. When the storm finally passes, {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note shine among the wreckage.

title: Fallen Fang
message: A single Leviathan tooth stands upright like a tower. Someone has drawn a tiny face on it and written, "His name is Gerald." Gerald's sheltering base happens to protect {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note from the surrounding currents.

title: Riven Trench
message: The seafloor fractures beside you. Instead of lava or darkness, the opening exposes gigantic bones continuing downward beyond sight. Whatever lies buried here is deeper than the trench itself. Before the crack settles, it releases {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Last Leviathan Song
message: A low musical note crosses the water, and nearby bones begin resonating in answer. It could be current singing through the remains - until something very far away seems to reply. The final vibration frees {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note. Nothing else moves.

title: Bone-Crown Reach
message: Huge curved bones form a crown around an enormous skull. Tiny harmless creatures have declared it a kingdom, with the smallest citizen seated exactly where a throne should be. Their miniature royal court has accumulated {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Wakeheart Vortex
message: A massive vortex turns steadily enough to drag wreckage around its rim, yet its exact center is perfectly calm. Reaching that silent eye takes a breathless plunge through the current. Within it float debris, a Travel Note, and {reward} Star Candies.

title: Titan-Scar Gate
message: Two gigantic claw scars intersect like a doorway. Crossing their center changes the pressure, current, and sound all at once. An old message reads, "That's definitely a gate. Probably. I'm calling it a gate." Beyond the not-quite gate lie {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Remembering Scale
message: Touching an ancient scale awakens impressions held within it: unfamiliar stars, something colossal moving below, and ancient Fae observing from far away. A later memory shows a familiar white-haired elf touch the same scale and recoil. It fades, revealing {reward} Star Candies and a Travel Note.

title: Grave of the First Wake
message: Bones, scars, wreckage, and terrain converge around a skeleton too enormous to comprehend; only part of it is visible before it disappears into the dark. An old folded Travel Note says, "I don't think we were ever supposed to find this." The remains slowly release {reward} Star Candies. LEGENDARY EXPEDITION!
